message: Command `ls /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/oniguruma/ && echo "---" && cat /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/build.sh` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: Let me explore the oniguruma source code and understand the vulnerability. The crash is in `gbNUMBER_mbc_enc_len`, `onigenc_mbn_mbc_to_code`, and `gbNUMBER_mbc_to_code` - this is related to the GB18030/GBK encoding in oniguruma.
